subject: rosy wolfsnail
title: This Snail Hunts Other Snails by Following Their Slime

scenes.text: This snail hunts other snails. They leave it a map.
The rosy wolfsnail, from the southeastern United States. It follows slime trails with feelers on its lips.
It moves at about eight millimeters a second, and swallows small snails whole, shell and all.
In 1955, Hawaii released 616 of them to wipe out an invasive giant snail.
It didn't touch the problem. It went for Hawaii's small native snails instead.
About eight native species are gone because of it. The hunter is still out there, following trails.

description:
The rosy wolfsnail is a predatory snail from the southeastern United States that tracks other snails by their slime trails and swallows the small ones whole.
In 1955 Hawaii released 616 of them on Oahu to control the invasive giant African land snail. That snail was never brought under control; the wolfsnail hunted Hawaii's native tree snails instead, and it is blamed for the extinction of about eight native species there and many more across the Pacific islands.
What is the worst idea anyone ever had for fixing nature? Comment below.
first_comment: Adults reach seven to ten centimetres. Which other animal was brought in to fix a problem and made it worse?
